title: Trace a EUR active-index producer through its caller
changes: Identify mode-dependent return domains of the active-index helper and a conditional byte-valued path into the active selector.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-active-id-helper-dis-wine-_emiu3kp and e158-byte00-active-id-preserve-dis-wine-kqba3yet inspect the original helper, caller and intervening routine.
Wine e158-byte00-active-id-callees-dis-wine-sy1sh_8p inspects additional intervening call windows; no gameplay execution was inferred.
limitations: The byte bound assumes the observed mode and return register survive intervening calls and no later writer intervenes; mode 1 can produce a ten-bit value and object identity, aliases, other writers, callback invocation and ordinary byte00 use remain open. Linux, USA and native Windows pending. No performance measurement.
